# Actors Lines

> Actors Lines is an Android app for actors learning their lines. It works on the phone itself: scripts are read and practised on the device, and your scripts stay on your phone.

What the app does:
- Imports a script by scanning paper pages with the camera or from a PDF, and builds the scenes, characters and lines.
- Practise a scene with a synthetic cast: computer voices (or your own recordings) speak the other characters' lines while you play your part, and your own lines can be hidden until you say them.
- Run cue to cue, loop difficult sections, and see accuracy scores for each line using on-device speech recognition.
- Selftape mode: record cue lines in your own voice for self-tapes and practice runs.
- Progress tracking: accuracy heat-maps by line and scene.

Availability: Android. An iPhone version is being explored; nothing is promised yet.
